background.evidence: Twelve years of consulting across three unrelated sectors. Adjacent to every domain, inside none.

connection.evidence: Always been fascinated. No moment, no consequence, no name.

essential.evidence: Asserts that waste matters, never says who is accountable when it happens.

spread.evidence: An analyst figure with no derivation and no bottom-up count.

icp.evidence: Any mid-sized company in Europe, then widened to enterprises in the same paragraph.

pain.evidence: Two third-party statistics. Nothing the founder observed or computed.

existingAttempts.evidence: Various productivity tools. Not one product named.

limitations.evidence: Legacy and expensive, with no mechanism for why an incumbent cannot close the gap.

solution.evidence: An operating system with four modules and no first workflow.

boundary.evidence: Four modules listed and not one exclusion anywhere. The product only ever adds.

falsifiable.evidence: Find a co-founder, build an MVP, raise. Three activities he controls, no result the market returns.

validation.evidence: Thirty positive conversations, a cold waitlist, and competitor funding cited as proof.

distribution.evidence: A menu of four channels with no first move.

nextSteps.evidence: Find a CTO, build an MVP, raise. Not one step involves a customer.

reasons: B2B, aimed at companies rather than consumers.
Founder left their job in June and is full time.
In scope is not the same as good. The scope score is the separate judgement.
